Bioengineered human muscle provides a controlled tissue-scale system for investigating development,
injury, repair and treatment response. It creates a human experimental context in which molecular
changes can be read directly against tissue function.

## Functional and neuromuscular models

The platform reports functional measurements, including contractile force, alongside quantitative
imaging and molecular profiling. It is being extended to motor neuron–muscle co-cultures and
multiplexed assays for modelling sarcopenia and studying differential treatment responses relevant
to precision medicine.
